title: Police budget: reduce requested increase to 7%
summary: Council considered limiting the Police Service budget increase to 7%.
notes: The motion states the target percentage but not the exact dollar reduction; no dollar amount is inferred.

title: Police budget returned for potential reductions
summary: Council directed the Police Services Board to consider potential reductions to its 2026 budget.
notes: Direction to reconsider; the motion itself did not set a dollar reduction.

title: Use $3M of Legacy income reserve to reduce the levy
summary: Council directed staff to use an additional $3 million from the Legacy reserve to reduce the 2026 net tax levy.
notes: This is the additional one-time 2026 levy offset, distinct from the regular use of Legacy investment income for capital.

title: Restore $32K of Library collections through the tax levy
summary: A motion to restore $32,000 of Library collections funding in the 2026 operating budget from the net tax levy was defeated.

title: Restore $32K of Library collections from reserve
summary: Council unanimously supported restoring $32,000 of Library collections funding from the Library Materials Acquisition Reserve.

title: Cap contingency budget at $1M
summary: Council considered capping the contingency budget at $1 million.
notes: The cap is explicit, but the source excerpt does not establish the exact delta from the draft amount; no savings amount is inferred.

title: Trinity overnight expansion: $269,280
summary: Funding to enhance the Trinity Overnight Drop-In Program failed on a 5–5 tie.
notes: Committee-stage vote. Subsequent Council consideration can be shown separately where the final disposition differs.

title: Housing Stability Fund: +$250,000

title: Trinity daytime hours: $244,800

title: Trinity overnight program: $264,000
